summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers and the engine-free plot function, and rewired the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard handlers as thin adapters. New files: monai/data/csv_saver.py, monai/data/nifti_saver.py, and five tests (test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, and the updated test_handler_classification_saver.py). Modified: nifti_writer.py default dtype to np.float32, img2tensorboard.py (plot_2d_or_3d_image), the three handlers, tests/integration_sliding_window.py, and the two segmentation evaluation examples (output_path renamed to output_dir). Nothing was committed. I did not run tests or flake8; verification was by reading only. Behavior changes to note: default CSV row order is now insertion order instead of sorted, and the TensorBoard image handler calls batch_transform once instead of twice. Two pre-existing long lines in monai/data/grid_dataset.py and monai/data/synthetic.py were left untouched.
